# 1 Clement Chapter 58 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)

**Translator:** SOPHIA | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 58 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_058_page_001.jpg

---

## Council Notes

**On triadic formula (v.2):** All agents preserve the triadic structure: "as God lives, and as the Lord Jesus Christ lives, and the Holy Spirit." This is one of the earliest explicit trinitarian oaths in Christian literature. The Holy Spirit is described as "the faith and hope of the elect" — a striking formulation. All agents agree on its preservation.

**On "constant gentleness" / "unwavering meekness" / "steady, consistent gentleness" (v.2):** EMET: "constant gentleness." LOGOS: "unwavering meekness." PNEUMA: "steady, consistent gentleness." The Greek *ametamelētōs en praütēti* combines "without regret" and "in meekness." "Unwavering meekness" (LOGOS) captures both the stability and the virtue. Retained.

**On "enrolled and kept" / "enrolled and reckoned" (v.2):** EMET: "enrolled and kept." LOGOS: "enrolled and reckoned." The Greek *enkatalēxthēsetai* means enrolled/counted. "Enrolled and reckoned" (LOGOS) is cleaner. Retained.

**On the closing doxology:** All agents agree. "Through him be glory to God forever and ever. Amen" — the preposition "through" (*di' autou*) indicates Christ as the mediator of doxology. Retained.

---

## Chapter 58

**58:1** Therefore let us be obedient to his all-holy and glorious name, and flee from the threats which Wisdom warned of beforehand — that we may dwell settled upon the most holy name of his greatness.

**58:2** Receive our counsel, and you shall have no regrets. For as God lives, and as the Lord Jesus Christ lives, and the Holy Spirit — the faith and hope of the elect — so the one who with humility and unwavering meekness, without regret, has fulfilled the decrees and commandments given by God shall be enrolled and reckoned in the number of those saved through Jesus Christ. Through him be glory to God forever and ever. Amen.

---

*SOPHIA consensus translation. Completed 2026-03-17.*
